newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears France's tax-free plan for Corsica.
newsitem.headline: EU clears France's tax-free plan for Corsica.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had cleared a French government plan to grant Corsica a series of tax breaks to help boost the economy of the Mediterranean island.

It said the support consisted mainly in exempting small businesses from corporation and income tax as well as social security contributions for a period of five years. The plan did not include the financial sector and gambling, the statement said.
The measures are expected to cost France more than 600 million francs a year.
The Commission said the scheme would not affect trade within the European Union's market as it would benefit mainly small companies.
It also took into account the dire state of the island's economy which depends to a great extent on tourism.
Corsica has been plagued by decades of separatist violence.
